notes.title: Update on the Removal of YouTube Feature
notes.notes:
Version Update Notification

Thank you for using PunchFit. In this update, we have removed the YouTube feature, which was previously available as a beta version. Despite our extensive efforts to officially launch this feature, we have been unable to secure the necessary cooperation from YouTube, leading us to this unfortunate decision.

Update Details:

Removal of YouTube Feature: We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and will continue to enhance other features.

Looking Forward:

We are committed to improving user experience and will be introducing new and alternative features to replace the YouTube function. Please look forward to future updates.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Update
notes.notes:
Hello to all users.

What a surprise, you can now play Punch Fit while watching YouTube.
Enjoy your fitness while playing your favorite videos and music.
You can use it by changing the BGM in the settings to YouTube.
*This is an addition as a beta feature.

With this update, features such as fine volume control have also been added.

We hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience.
1. "Valve Index" and "HTC VIVE" are now supported.
2. in-game position reset function added.
Devices other than "Meta Quest" are now supported.
We have tested the game on "Valve Index" and "HTC VIVE". 
We were not able to test on all devices, but we believe the game is now playable on many devices.
Please let us know if you experience any glitches.
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update.
notes.notes:
*Adjusted vibration feedback to the controller when punching.
Effects, sounds, vibrations and drop points change with weak and strong punches.

*Calorie consumption display adjustment.
A mistake was made in the calorie notation at the time of results, which has been corrected.
We recommend using Quest's Move app to record calories and exercise.

*Fixed other minor bugs.
